title: Predicting Spatiotemporal Mobile Sensing-Based PM2.5 Concentrations Using Low-Rank Adapted Spatially Attentive Graph Neural Network
abstract: arXiv:2609.04693v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Urban air quality can vary significantly along transit corridors, necessitating high-resolution monitoring. This work introduces a novel mobile-sensing dataset from Surat, Gujarat, India, comprising PM$*{2.5}$ concentrations, meteorological variables (temperature, humidity, wind speed, wind direction), and land-use features. To represent the spatiotemporal data as a graph, two node-definition strategies were used: (i) uniform segmentation (200--400~m intervals) and (ii) DBSCAN clustering to adaptively group dense observations. For each node, rolling mean and standard deviation of meteorological variables were computed. To model this high-dimensional data, we propose a SA-GNN for fine-grained, short-term PM$*{2.5}$ forecasting and hotspot identification. We compared SA-GNN with LSTM, RNN, GRU, and ANN models. translated_title: 使用低秩自适应空间注意力图神经网络预测基于移动感知的时空PM2.5浓度
translated_abstract: 城市空气质量在交通走廊沿线可能存在显著变化，因此需要高分辨率监测。这项工作介绍了一个来自印度古吉拉特邦苏拉特市的新型移动感知数据集，包含PM2.5浓度、气象变量（温度、湿度、风速、风向）和土地利用特征。为了将时空数据表示为图，研究者采用了两种节点定义策略：（i）均匀分割（200-400米间隔）和（ii）使用DBSCAN聚类对密集观测进行自适应分组。对于每个节点，计算了气象变量的滚动均值和标准差。为了对这一高维数据进行建模，研究者提出了一种用于细粒度、短期PM2.5预测和热点识别的空间注意力图神经网络（SA-GNN）。研究者将SA-GNN与LSTM、RNN、GRU和ANN模型进行了比较。这些模型在低分辨率数据上表现良好，但难以捕捉城市空气质量中快速变化的模式。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种低秩自适应的空间注意力图神经网络（SA-GNN），利用印度苏拉特市的新型移动感知数据集，实现了细粒度的短期PM2.5浓度预测和热点识别，其性能优于传统的LSTM、RNN、GRU和ANN模型。
